name: cuButterfly layered architecture

templates.role: CUDA kernels and generated processing-unit templates

platform_profiles.role: GPU capabilities, compiler target, and measured hardware facts

parameters.role: legal architecture axes, decomposition, layout, precision, and launch parameters

search_and_calibration.role: candidate enumeration, exclusive benchmark, fitting, and promotion

runtime_selection.role: exact local points and generated fallback selectors

target-local.performance_claim: only for the fingerprinted GPU and measured semantic cell

invariants: templates do not select a GPU profile
profiles do not contain kernel implementation code
search results are not runtime selectors until correctness and identity checks pass
historical v100 evidence is never silently reused as a target-local measurement
